<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B>EXPLANATORY NOTE</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">This Form&nbsp;8-A/A amends and supplements the Form&nbsp;8-A filed
by the registrant, dated June&nbsp;5, 2009 (the &ldquo;<U>Original 8-A</U>&rdquo;), as amended by the Form&nbsp;8-A/A filed by the registrant,
dated April&nbsp;13, 2018, and the Form&nbsp;8-A/A filed by the registrant, dated April&nbsp;11, 2022, to reflect the expiration of the
preferred share purchase rights of the registrant registered on the Original 8-A.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>Item 1. Description of Registrant&rsquo;s Securities to be Registered.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Item 1 of the Original 8-A is amended by substituting the following:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.25in">On June&nbsp;1, 2009, the Board of Directors (the
 &ldquo;<U>Board</U>&rdquo;) of Arlington Asset Investment Corp., a Virginia corporation, formerly known as Friedman, Billings, Ramsey
Group,&nbsp;Inc. (the &ldquo;<U>Company</U>&rdquo;), adopted a rights agreement and declared a dividend, payable to shareholders of record
as of the close of business on June&nbsp;5, 2009, of one preferred share purchase right (&ldquo;<U>Right</U>&rdquo;) for each outstanding
share of the Company&rsquo;s Class&nbsp;A common stock, par value $0.01 per share (<U>&ldquo;Class&nbsp;A common stock</U>&rdquo;), and
Class&nbsp;B common stock, par value $0.01 per share (&ldquo;<U>Class&nbsp;B common stock</U>&rdquo;), with such Rights originally to
expire on June&nbsp;4, 2019. The description and terms of the Rights are set forth in a Rights Agreement, dated as of June&nbsp;5, 2009
(the &ldquo;<U>Original Rights Agreement</U>&rdquo;), by and between the Company and American Stock Transfer&nbsp;&amp; Trust Company,
LLC, as rights agent. On April&nbsp;9, 2018, the Board approved and the Company adopted a First Amendment to the Original Rights Agreement
(the &ldquo;<U>First Amendment</U>&rdquo;). The First Amendment extended the expiration date of the Rights until June&nbsp;4, 2022. No
shareholder approval was required for adoption of the First Amendment and the Company&rsquo;s shareholders approved the First Amendment
at the 2018 annual meeting of shareholders. On April&nbsp;11, 2022, the Board approved and the Company adopted a Second Amendment (the
 &ldquo;<U>Second Amendmen</U>t&rdquo;) to the Original Rights Agreement. The Second Amendment extended the expiration date of the Rights
until June&nbsp;4, 2025. No shareholder approval was required for adoption of the Second Amendment and the Company&rsquo;s shareholders
approved the Second Amendment at the 2022 annual meeting of shareholders.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">On December&nbsp;14, 2023, the Company entered
into the Third Amendment (the &ldquo;<U>Third Amendment</U>&rdquo;) to the Original Rights Agreement (as amended by the First Amendment,
the Second Amendment and the Third Amendment, together, the &ldquo;<U>Rights Agreement</U>&rdquo;), with Equiniti Trust Company, LLC (f/k/a
American Stock Transfer&nbsp;&amp; Trust Company, LLC), as rights agent. The Third Amendment accelerates the expiration of the Rights
under the Rights Agreement by amending the definition of &ldquo;Final Expiration Date&rdquo; to mean 9:00 a.m., Eastern Time, on December&nbsp;14,
2023. Consequently, the Rights Agreement terminated at that time. At the time of the termination of the Rights Agreement, all Rights distributed
to holders of the Company&rsquo;s Class&nbsp;A common stock and Class&nbsp;B common stock pursuant to the Rights Agreement expired. No
shareholder approval is required for adoption of the Third Amendment.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.25in">The foregoing description does not purport to
be complete and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the full text of the Original Rights Agreement, the First Amendment, the
Second Amendment and the Third Amendment, which are filed as Exhibits 4.1, 4.2, 4.3 and 4.4, respectively, to this registration statement.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: right"><B>Exhibit 4.4</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B>THIRD AMENDMENT</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B>TO</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B>RIGHTS AGREEMENT</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">THIS THIRD AMENDMENT TO RIGHTS AGREEMENT (this
 &ldquo;<B>Third Amendment</B>&rdquo;), is made as of this 14<SUP>th</SUP> day of December, 2023 between <B>ARLINGTON ASSET INVESTMENT
CORP.</B>, a Virginia corporation formerly known as Friedman, Billings, Ramsey Group,&nbsp;Inc. (the &ldquo;<B>Company</B>&rdquo;), and
<B>EQUINITI TRUST COMPANY, LLC</B>, a New York limited liability company formerly known as American Stock Transfer&nbsp;&amp; Trust Company,
LLC (the &ldquo;<B>Rights Agent</B>&rdquo;).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B>RECITALS</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">A.</FONT>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">The
Company and the Rights Agent are parties to that certain Rights Agreement, dated as of June&nbsp;5, 2009, as amended by that certain First
Amendment to the Rights Agreement, between the Company and the Rights Agent, dated as of April&nbsp;13, 2018, and that certain Second
Amendment to the Rights Agreement, dated as of April&nbsp;11, 2022 (as so amended, the &ldquo;<B>Rights Agreement</B>&rdquo;).</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">B.</FONT>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Pursuant
to Section&nbsp;26 of the Rights Agreement, prior to the Distribution Date, the Company may, in its sole and absolute discretion, and
the Rights Agent shall, if the Company so directs, supplement or amend any provision of the Rights Agreement in any respect without the
approval of any holders of Rights, with any such supplement or amendment to be evidenced by a writing signed by the Company and the Rights
Agent. The Distribution Date has not yet occurred.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">C.</FONT>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">This
Third Amendment is being adopted substantially concurrently with the completion of the transactions (the &ldquo;<B>Merger</B>&rdquo;)
contemplated by the Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated May&nbsp;29, 2023, by and among the Company, Ellington Financial Inc., a Delaware
corporation, EF Merger Sub Inc., a Virginia corporation, and, solely for the limited purposes set forth therein, Ellington Financial Management
LLC, a Delaware limited liability company.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">D.</FONT>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">In
connection with the Merger, the Board of Directors of the Company has determined that it is in the best interest of the Company to amend
the Rights Agreement as provided in this Third Amendment.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">E.</FONT>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">The
Company has delivered to the Rights Agent a certificate from an appropriate officer of the Company stating that this Third Amendment complies
with Section&nbsp;26 of the Rights Agreement.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">F.</FONT>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">The
Company and the Rights Agent desire to amend the Rights Agreement to accelerate the expiration date of the Rights.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>NOW THEREFORE</B>, for good and valuable consideration,
the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the Company and the Rights Agent hereby agree as follows:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>1.</B></FONT><B>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><U>Definitions</U></FONT></B><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">.
Except as otherwise set forth in this Third Amendment, each capitalized term used in this Third Amendment shall have the meaning for such
term set forth in the Rights Agreement.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>2.</B></FONT><B>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><U>Definition
of &ldquo;Agreement&rdquo;</U></FONT></B><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">. From and after the date hereof all references in the Rights Agreement
to the &ldquo;Agreement&rdquo; shall mean and refer to the Rights Agreement as modified by this Third Amendment.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>3.</B></FONT><B>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><U>Definition
of &ldquo;Expiration Date&rdquo;</U></FONT></B><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">. Section&nbsp;1(x)&nbsp;of the Rights Agreement is hereby
amended by deleting the reference to &ldquo;the final date of the Company&rsquo;s 2022 annual meeting of shareholders&rdquo; and replacing
it with a reference to &ldquo;9:00 a.m., New York City time, on December&nbsp;14, 2023, to coincide with the closing of the Merger.&rdquo;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>4.</B></FONT><B>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><U>Definition
of &ldquo;Final Expiration Date&rdquo;</U></FONT></B><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">. Section&nbsp;1(y)&nbsp;of the Rights Agreement is
hereby amended by deleting the reference to &ldquo;June&nbsp;4, 2025&rdquo; and replacing it with a reference to &ldquo;9:00 a.m., New
York City time, on December&nbsp;14, 2023, to coincide with the closing of the Merger.&rdquo;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>5.</B></FONT><B>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><U>Form&nbsp;of
Rights Certificate</U></FONT></B><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">. Exhibit&nbsp;B to the Rights Agreement is hereby amended as follows:</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">a.</TD><TD>By deleting each reference to &ldquo;June&nbsp;4, 2025&rdquo; included in Exhibit&nbsp;B and replacing it with reference to &ldquo;December&nbsp;14,
2023.&rdquo;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>6.</B></FONT><B>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><U>Summary
of Rights</U></FONT></B><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">. Exhibit&nbsp;C to the Rights Agreement is hereby amended as follows:</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">a.</TD><TD>By deleting the reference to &ldquo;June&nbsp;4, 2025&rdquo; and replacing it with a reference to &ldquo;December&nbsp;14, 2023.&rdquo;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 1in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">b.</TD><TD>By deleting reference to &ldquo;June&nbsp;4, 2022&rdquo; and replacing it with reference to &ldquo;December&nbsp;14, 2023.&rdquo;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>7.</B></FONT><B>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><U>Ratification
of Agreement</U></FONT></B><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">. Except as specifically modified by this Third Amendment, the Rights Agreement
remains in full force and effect and is hereby ratified, confirmed and reaffirmed for all purposes and in all respects.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>8.</B></FONT><B>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><U>Counterparts</U></FONT></B><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">.
This Third Amendment may be executed in one or more counterparts, each of which shall constitute an original and all of which together
shall constitute but one original; provided, however, this Third Amendment shall not be effective unless and until signed by the Company
and the Rights Agent.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">[<I>Signature Page&nbsp;Follows</I>]</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>
